work.composition: left-aligned plane with disc and snapshot drift
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three gold compact discs, a side-view warplane drawing, postage stamps, polaroid-style photographic prints, and multicolored painted ribbons against a predominantly white ground. Concentric target rings appear at upper center and lower left, alongside holographic foil fragments, hand-drawn architectural lines, and bold red, yellow, and black gestural strokes.
work.title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)
